podcast.title: Backstage Behavior on Roseanne
podcast.body: Arnold was known for the drama he caused backstage, serving as Barr's "henchman" and executing her "often crazy demands and routine firings." He and Barr exerted power over scripts, rewriting them after each read-through, which created tension among the writing staff. "He was basically served as Barr's henchman, executing her often crazy demands and routine firings."

podcast.body: After Matt Williams' departure, Tom Arnold, who was then Rosanne Barr's husband, was added to the writing team for the show. He also played a reoccurring character on the series. "After Williams left, Barr added her new husband, Tom Arnold, to the writing team."

xref.title: Control and Backstage Drama with Tom Arnold
xref.body: After Matt Williams left, Barr added her new husband, Tom Arnold, to the writing team. Arnold also played a reoccurring character but was notorious for causing drama backstage. He acted as Barr's "henchman," executing her demands and routine firings. The couple exerted significant power over scripts, rewriting them after each read-through, which caused tension among the constantly changing writing staff. "He was basically served as Barr's henchman, executing her often crazy demands and routine firings."
